_note: Run scripts\update_mod_browser.ps1 to refresh stamp, version, zip, bytes, sha, sha256, keys, requires, loadAfter, preset, defaultOff and alwaysOn. Edit icon, category, summary and details by hand, then copy stamp to checked. category is one of Scenes, Gameplay, Maps, Visual, Tools.

mods.title: Admin Panel
mods.summary: Cheat panel opened from a button in the pause menu.
mods.details: Adds an Admin Panel button to the pause menu. The panel holds cheats and the settings for other mods, such as the Enemy Randomizer and a button to enter the Backrooms. Esc closes it. It also works with a controller: the pause menu's highlight reaches the button and A opens it, then the D-pad or left stick moves, left and right change a setting, A selects, B goes back and Start closes. The controller needs ModKit 1.1.0, from the newest patch, and was tested in game with a virtual Xbox controller. 1.1.1 fixes the arrows of the settings rows, which did nothing with the mouse in 1.1.0.

mods.title: Enemy Randomizer
mods.summary: Any regular enemy, or a pair from another mod, can appear at any spawn point on any floor.
mods.details: Shuffles which enemies appear in the dungeon. Each enemy gets a spawn percent, and spawn points can be left empty. Set it up in the Admin Panel or in mod-randomizer.json, which is read at launch. Version 1.2.0 lets other mods add pairs to the mix: with Gooner DLC installed, its nurse pair scenes can turn up at dungeon spawn points instead of an enemy, and each kind gets its own row on the Admin Panel tab to set how often it appears or to turn it off. Without a mod that offers pairs, nothing changes.

mods.title: Backrooms
mods.summary: A door to a Backrooms dungeon of 3 to 10 floors, built like the game's own dungeons.
mods.details: A door in the Starting Hall and in Free Mode leads to the Lobby, the Backrooms' starting zone. Each visit, the game's own dungeon builder puts together 3 to 10 floors out of Backrooms rooms, behind the game's loading screen and its floor-by-floor loading sequence. As in the game's dungeons, travel doors join the floors, some exits stay locked until you find that floor's obsidian key, and the map shows each floor. Smilers, Mannequins and Lost Souls roam the floors, with ammo to find. A door in the Lobby and the last floor's door lead back out. The Admin Panel can also send you there. Version 2.1.0 dims the rooms to a fluorescent look (they were washed out), stands the elevator door flat against its wall, and, in a party run of the Multiplayer Hub mod, gives everyone in the party the same Backrooms (checked with two copies of the game off screen). Not included with the patch; get it from the Get Mods tab.

mods.title: Monitor Setting
mods.summary: Adds a Monitor row to the video settings.
mods.details: Pick which monitor the game shows on from the game's own video settings, for setups with more than one screen.

mods.title: Ghost Kiss
mods.summary: Lost Souls sometimes pair up and kiss.
mods.details: Each Lost Soul has a chance to gain a partner and start kissing, and the pair stays facing each other. They ignore you until you get close or hurt one. A kissing pair shows the game's own prompt: hold Interact and, with enough lust, you grab both heads for a double scene. Played to the end it finishes like the game's own scenes: with the Purification perk both are purified, and without it they go back to kissing. Interact again lets go early, with E or the controller's Interact button (the controller needs ModKit 1.1.0). A single Lost Soul also gets a Neck scene in the game's own scene lists, beside its blowjob: switch to it with D in Free Mode, or pick it from the Sex scenes on the wheel. The game runs it like its own, with its stages and climax bar. The double scene has only been tested without graphics.

mods.title: ModKit
mods.summary: Shared code the other mods rely on.
mods.details: Logging, safe loops and keys, messages between mods, settings menu sliders, and a Pad module that lets mods read controller buttons. Since 1.1.0 the controller can reach and move the settings menu sliders. Always on, and comes with the patch. To update it, run the newest patch again.

mods.title: Gooner DLC
mods.summary: Twisted Nurse variations, 74 extra pair animations, 33 new player scenes, Freecam, a Free Mode scene picker and a Boss Timer switch, in one mod.
mods.details: Some Twisted Nurses are found touching themselves until woken, some are futa, and some appear in pairs: groping, snuggling, from behind, riding, kissing, the Banshee's Behind and Carry scenes, or one of 74 extra pair animations. The player gets Kiss From Behind and 33 new scenes with the Twisted, Twisted Nurse and Witness: a 50% chance in dungeons, set in the Admin Panel, and always in their Free Mode scene lists. In any sex scene, the Perspective key (middle mouse, or the right stick click) now goes first person, third person, then Freecam: fly with WASD and the mouse or the sticks, Space/Ctrl or RB/LB for up and down, Shift or LT faster; the next press puts the camera back. In a Free Mode scene list, Tab (Y on a controller) opens a list of every scene to click straight to one, shown by a Tab prompt above Next Stage. The Admin Panel's Gooner DLC tab has a Boss Timer setting: Off stops the countdown before a dungeon's stalker boss arrives, so it never comes (a boss already there stays), and hides the countdown. It is remembered between launches and has only been tested without graphics. It contains Nurse Touch, so don't run the separate Nurse Touch mod as well. Also gives other mods the AnimationsPlus animation library. The extra animations are retargeted from the OLL Animations (AP) pack for WickedWhims. Not included with the patch; get it from the Get Mods tab.

mods.title: Model Studio
mods.summary: A solo studio room for looking at your player from every side, with a sex scene preview.
mods.details: Main menu > Extras > Model Studio (or the Admin Panel's Model Studio tab) opens a grey studio room with a plinth and a 1 m floor grid. F5 or the middle mouse switches between first person, an orbit camera (mouse turns, wheel zooms, W/S raise and lower the view) and a freecam (WASD and mouse). F6 switches the pose between the game's idle and the rest pose, F7 turns a turntable on or off. The scene preview puts one of Free Mode's 18 characters in front of you with that character's own scene list, so the game runs its scenes as in Free Mode (W/S stages, D the next scene): pick the partner in the Admin Panel tab, then F9 or Start scene preview, and F9 or Stop to end it. Only the game's own scenes are listed. Keyboard and mouse only. Off by default: install it from Get Mods, then tick it in the Mods tab. Tested off screen; not yet played with graphics.

mods.title: Multiplayer Hub
mods.summary: Play with Steam friends: meet in the Starting Hall, talk with proximity voice chat, and go into dungeons together.
mods.details: Main menu > Extras > Multiplayer Hub hosts a hub or joins a Steam friend's (friends and invites only). Up to 8 players meet in the Starting Hall and see each other move, with name tags. Voice chat is proximity based: full volume up close, quieter with distance, silent past 25 m, from the side the speaker stands on, and muffled through walls; a name tag turns green while that player talks. Hold V to talk, or set Talk to Press V on / off. When anyone holds E on a portal (or the Backrooms door), everyone in the hub goes, and everyone gets the same dungeon: the same rooms, doors, locked doors, keys and chests, and a chest one player opens is open and empty for the others. When the leader goes back to the hall, everyone follows. In a hub you play a separate multiplayer character with its own save, first copied from your own, so your campaign saves are never written. Esc > Multiplayer Hub in a hub has invites, the players with their pings, the voice settings, a voice test and Leave hub. An early build: other players are placeholder bodies with no walk animation, each player fights their own copy of the enemies, there is no text chat, talking is keyboard only, and voice uses Windows' default microphone and speakers with no echo cancelling. Everyone needs the Steam version of the game and this mod; the same Backrooms for everyone needs Backrooms 2.1.0 on every PC. Tested with two copies of the game on one PC, off screen; play between two PCs has only been tried once, with an earlier version. Not included with the patch; get it from the Get Mods tab.

mods.title: Skin Swapper
mods.summary: Wear your own outfits and bodies made in Blender: the in-game half of the Skin Kit, with the Blender exporter add-on included.
mods.details: Puts skins made with the Skin Kit on the player: a new body texture or a whole new body mesh, and outfit pieces (clothes, hair, accessories) that follow the body's bones. Pick the skin in the Admin Panel's Skins tab: Game default, any installed skin, or Live preview. Each piece can show in first person and stay on in sex scenes or come off there. Live preview shows a skin straight from Blender while the game runs. The mod folder's Blender folder holds the Sin Spire Skin Exporter add-on (Blender 4.2 or newer), which checks the model against the game's player rig and exports it; building an export into something the game loads also needs Unreal Engine 5.3 and the Skin Kit's build scripts, shared separately. Off by default: install it from Get Mods, then tick it in the Mods tab. Tested with a sample skin, including Live preview; first-person pieces not yet seen in play.

mods.title: Lustful Distractions
mods.summary: Plant and headcrab pairs busy with each other around each level.
mods.details: Pairs turn up at random spots around each level and in Free Mode, too taken with each other to notice you. Two penis plants rub their tips together, one docks inside another, two mash their heads together and fail to dock, a penis plant works away inside a mouth plant, one headcrab rides another, and now and then a mouth plant takes a headcrab instead. Every so often a pair gets excited and slams, and less often it climaxes; the crabs also fight to get away and are held back, and rarely one breaks free, is chased down and is caught. Separate plant and crab volume sliders sit in the settings menu, and the Admin Panel can place pairs and set them off. This is Plant Distractor and Crab Pair merged into one mod: if you have either of those, turn it off in the mod list first, or you will get both sets of pairs.
